name: Outliner
description: Lists that work like an outliner in the editor: move an item up or down with its children (⌘⇧↑, ⌘⇧↓), Tab and Shift-Tab indent and outdent it with them, Enter on an empty item steps out a level, ⌘A selects the item's text and then the whole list, and ⌘↑ and ⌘↓ fold and unfold it.
author: Vaultite
